edition.publication: London: Longman, Green, Longman and Roberts, 1862-1865
edition.title: The Targums of Onkelos and Jonathan Ben Uzziel on the Pentateuch, translated by J. W. Etheridge

work.author: Anonymous; traditionally ascribed to Jonathan ben Uzziel
work.description: An expansive Palestinian Aramaic targum of the Pentateuch, transmitted under a mistaken ascription to Jonathan ben Uzziel and reaching its present form late. Unlike Onkelos it inserts narrative and homiletic material freely; its expansions at Genesis 15:12 and 15:17 introduce the four kingdoms and Gehinnom. Its willingness to expand makes its silences evidential in the same way as Onkelos's fidelity. A locus is BookToken.chapter.verse.
work.title: Targum Pseudo-Jonathan
